relationships.subject: ELN441958
relationships.evidence_quote: ELN441958 is a non-peptide antagonist selectively inhibiting B1R with high oral bioavailability and potent systemic efficacy in rhesus monkey inflammatory pain

relationships.subject: Win64338
relationships.evidence_quote: Win64338 could spatially compete with the agonist, resulting in an antagonistic effect.

relationships.subject: R715
relationships.evidence_quote: In our B1R-R715 complex structure, R715 is positioned within the orthosteric binding pocket (OBP)

key_findings: Cryo-EM structures of B1R with R715 and ELN441958 and B2R with Win64338 reveal antagonist binding modes.
Non-conserved residues at positions 6.51, 7.39 and 7.43 contribute to B1R/B2R antagonist selectivity; antagonists restrict the W6.48 toggle switch.
